not_yet: Why the last vowel changes after لَمْ and لَنْ. Just read it as written.

items.model: No. لَمْ needs the present verb: لَمْ يَذْهَبِ الْوَلَدُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ. (Or keep the past verb with مَا: مَا ذَهَبَ الْوَلَدُ.)

items.en: Sara says this is right. Is she?
items.model: No. After لَنْ the verb ends in ـَ: لَنْ يَكْتُبَ الطَّالِبُ.

items.en: Omar says this means “the boy did not drink the water”. Is he right?
items.model: No. لَا goes with the present (لَا يَشْرَبُ = does not drink). For “did not drink” say مَا شَرِبَ or لَمْ يَشْرَبْ.
